shortDescription: Replication session operations on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: filesystem
options.description: Name/ID of the filesystem for which replication session exists. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: Name/ID of the NAS server for which replication session exists. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: replication_group
options.description: Name or ID of the replication group for which replication session exists. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: role
options.description: Role of the metro replication session.

options.name: session_id
options.description: ID of the replication session. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: session_state
options.description: State in which the replication session is present after performing the task.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: volume
options.description: Name/ID of the volume for which replication session exists. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: volume_group
options.description: Name/ID of the volume group for which a replication session exists. Parameter I(filesystem), I(nas_server), I(volume_group), I(volume), I(replication_group), and I(session_id) are mutually exclusive.
